notes: w64devkit 1.19.0 (Christopher Wellons): a portable MinGW-w64 toolchain with NASM 2.15.05, GCC 13.1.0, GNU binutils 2.40 and GDB 13.1. The archive's OpenPGP signature (key 5EEB8C8D5069C4E9B94AA852AFD1503A8C8FF42A) was verified when it was pinned; its SHA-256 is checked before anything is extracted. Run Code assembles .asm files with NASM, links them with gcc (GNU ld) and runs the program; .s/.S files are assembled with GNU as through gcc. Only these toolchain commands are added to OpenMind terminals (as small launchers); the other programs w64devkit ships (busybox's find, sort, tar ...) are not, so Windows' own commands keep working. x86 (32-bit) programs need the optional x86 toolchain add-on, which installs into its own w64devkit folder inside this install. w64devkit 1.23.0 is not used: Microsoft Defender flags its archive. The system PATH is not changed.
